sloka: राक्षसानां समुद्योगं तं तु नारायणः प्रभुः ।देवदूतादुपश्रुत्य चक्रे युद्धे तदा मनः ।। ७.६.६२ ॥
transliteration: rākṣasānāṁ samudyogaṁ taṁ tu nārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ।devadūtādupaśrutya cakre yuddhe tadā manaḥ ।। 7.6.62 ॥

translations.english: He, with weapons and quivers ready, stood upon Vainateya (Garuda), having donned his divine armor that shone with the brilliance of a thousand suns.
